elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your Mac remembers every Wi-Fi password you've ever typed.

[confident] Here's the fix. Open the Passwords app.

[friendly] Click Wi-Fi in the sidebar. Pick your network. The password's right there. Or show the QR code and let them scan it.

[delighted] Your guest scans it and they're on. No router sticker.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
